description: The file defines the SyncEngine class responsible for synchronizing notes between a local repository and a remote API, observing network connectivity, and handling asynchronous sync operations.

classes.name: SyncEngine
classes.description: A class managing synchronization of notes with remote API, observing network status, and providing start and one-time sync functionalities.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializer injecting dependencies: repository, remote API, and network monitor.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins observing network status and triggers periodic sync when online.

methods.name: syncOnce
methods.description: Performs a single synchronization cycle: pushing dirty notes and pulling remote notes to reconcile locally.
